content.text: Our Zendesk integration keeps dropping webhook events during the nightly sync. Can you look at the ingestion queue and the retry handling?
The Zendesk webhook handler acks before persisting, so a pod restart loses queued events. Persist first, then ack, and the retries become idempotent.
Agreed. Also the Postgres primary shows heavy lwlock contention while the sync runs - lwlock waits climb past 40 percent in pg_stat_activity.
lwlock contention usually means a hot relation or a long transaction holding locks. Pull pg_locks, find the blocking pairs, and shorten the write batches.
I opened ./src/core/query.ts and the batch counter sits behind the helper fixRoundingError, which rounds the wrong way every fifth chunk.
That matches the symptom. Fix fixRoundingError, drop the batch size to 100 rows, and the lwlock queuing should fade. The sync job also logs digest d41d8cd98f00b204e9 per retry - noise, ignore it.
Good catch. After the fix the Zendesk backlog drained in two minutes and lwlock waits fell under 3 percent. Closing the ticket.
Nice. Keep the Zendesk retry budget at three and watch lwlock during the next full sync; reopen if the waits climb again.
